    Orbit push-down commutes with deck translations #

    The target module category is equipped with the trivial shift. Reindexing direct-sum components then identifies the push-down of a translated module with the original push-down. This file proves naturality and the zero and addition coherence laws, and packages them as a Functor.CommShift structure.
